; Shared note-enhancements source for Paper Pro and Move 3.27/3.28.
; The build step derives the 3.27 Settings navigation boundary.

AFFECT /qml/device/view/settings/Settings.qml
    TRAVERSE ?#settingsSidebar
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL
        INSERT {
            property var rmtoolNoteSettingsRoot: parent

            function rmtoolNoteSelectedPage() {
                return ("_selectedPage" in rmtoolNoteSettingsRoot)
                    ? rmtoolNoteSettingsRoot._selectedPage
                    : rmtoolNoteSettingsRoot._selectedIndex
            }

            function rmtoolSelectNotePage(page) {
                if ("_selectedPage" in rmtoolNoteSettingsRoot) {
                    rmtoolNoteSettingsRoot._selectedPage = page
                } else {
                    rmtoolNoteSettingsRoot._selectedIndex = page
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE

    TRAVERSE ?#settingsSidebar > ColumnLayout#settingsColumn
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            ArkControls.SidebarItem {
                id: rmtoolNoteEnhancementsSidebarItem
                objectName: "rmtoolNoteEnhancementsSidebarItem"
                type: ArkTokens.Sidebar.primary
                text: showLabels ? "笔记增强" : ""
                iconSource: "qrc:/ark/icons/notebook"
                highlighted: settingsSidebar.rmtoolNoteSelectedPage() === 1002
                focusPolicy: Qt.StrongFocus
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                onTriggered: {
                    settingsSidebar.rmtoolSelectNotePage(1002)
                    sidebarTimer.running = true
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE

    TRAVERSE ?#payloadLoader
        REBUILD sourceComponent
            LOCATE AFTER STREAM /{/
            INSERT STREAM /if (settingsSidebar.rmtoolNoteSelectedPage() === 1002) return rmtoolNoteEnhancements;/
        END REBUILD
    END TRAVERSE

    TRAVERSE Item#root
        LOCATE BEFORE Component#general
        INSERT {
            Component {
                id: rmtoolNoteEnhancements

                Item {
                    id: rmtoolNotePage
                    objectName: "rmtoolNoteEnhancementsPage"

                    readonly property string group: "RmtoolNoteEnhancements"
                    readonly property var delayChoices: [5, 10, 30]
                    property bool masterEnabled: true
                    property bool delayedColorRefreshEnabled: false
                    property int delaySeconds: 10
                    property string settlementPolicy: "idle"

                    function readBool(key, fallback) {
                        const value = Settings.rawValue(group, key)
                        return value === undefined || value === null ? fallback : !!value
                    }

                    function normalizedDelay(value) {
                        const number = Number(value)
                        return delayChoices.indexOf(number) >= 0 ? number : 10
                    }

                    function normalizedPolicy(value) {
                        return value === "page" ? "page" : "idle"
                    }

                    function readSettings() {
                        masterEnabled = readBool("masterEnabled", true)
                        delayedColorRefreshEnabled = readBool(
                            "delayedColorRefreshEnabled", false)
                        delaySeconds = normalizedDelay(
                            Settings.rawValue(group, "delaySeconds"))
                        settlementPolicy = normalizedPolicy(
                            Settings.rawValue(group, "settlementPolicy"))
                    }

                    function writeBool(key, value) {
                        Settings.setRawValue(group, key, !!value)
                        readSettings()
                    }

                    function writeDelay(value) {
                        Settings.setRawValue(group, "delaySeconds", normalizedDelay(value))
                        readSettings()
                    }

                    function writePolicy(value) {
                        Settings.setRawValue(group, "settlementPolicy", normalizedPolicy(value))
                        readSettings()
                    }

                    function stepDelay(delta) {
                        const index = delayChoices.indexOf(delaySeconds)
                        const next = Math.max(
                            0, Math.min(delayChoices.length - 1, index + delta))
                        writeDelay(delayChoices[next])
                    }

                    Component.onCompleted: readSettings()

                    ScrollArea {
                        id: rmtoolNoteScroll
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        contentWidth: width
                        contentHeight: rmtoolNoteWrapper.childrenRect.height
                            + ArkControls.Values.platform.spacing.x2large
                        enableScrollbar: true
                        permanentScrollbar: true
                        scrollbarTopMargin: rmtoolNoteHeader.y

                        Item {
                            id: rmtoolNoteWrapper
                            implicitWidth: rmtoolNoteScroll.width

                            ArkControls.PlaceholderBar {
                                id: rmtoolNotePlaceholder
                                width: parent.width
                            }

                            ArkControls.Title {
                                id: rmtoolNoteHeader
                                type: ArkControls.Title.Large
                                anchors {
                                    top: rmtoolNotePlaceholder.bottom
                                    left: parent.left
                                    leftMargin: ArkControls.Values.margin.horizontal.large
                                    right: parent.right
                                    rightMargin: ArkControls.Values.margin.horizontal.large
                                }
                                text: "笔记增强"
                            }

                            ColumnLayout {
                                anchors {
                                    top: rmtoolNoteHeader.bottom
                                    topMargin: ArkControls.Values.platform.spacing.x2large
                                    left: parent.left
                                    leftMargin: ArkControls.Values.margin.horizontal.large
                                    right: parent.right
                                    rightMargin: ArkControls.Values.margin.horizontal.large
                                }
                                spacing: ArkControls.Values.platform.spacing.x2large

                                ArkControls.Panel {
                                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                                    label: "启用笔记增强"
                                    description: "关闭后恢复系统原生笔记行为，已保存的设置会保留。"
                                    action: ArkToggleWrapper {
                                        checked: rmtoolNotePage.masterEnabled
                                        extendedMouseArea.onPressed: rmtoolNotePage.writeBool(
                                            "masterEnabled", !rmtoolNotePage.masterEnabled)
                                    }
                                }

                                ArkControls.Panel {
                                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                                    label: "延迟彩色刷新"
                                    description: "减少彩色书写提笔后的频繁闪烁；最终显色会相应延后。"
                                    enabled: rmtoolNotePage.masterEnabled
                                    opacity: enabled ? 1 : 0.5
                                    action: ArkToggleWrapper {
                                        checked: rmtoolNotePage.delayedColorRefreshEnabled
                                        extendedMouseArea.onPressed: rmtoolNotePage.writeBool(
                                            "delayedColorRefreshEnabled",
                                            !rmtoolNotePage.delayedColorRefreshEnabled)
                                    }
                                }

                                ArkControls.Panel {
                                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                                    label: "仅翻页刷新"
                                    description: "书写时保留临时显色，在翻页或离开笔记时完成最终渲染。"
                                    enabled: rmtoolNotePage.masterEnabled
                                        && rmtoolNotePage.delayedColorRefreshEnabled
                                        && rmtoolNotePage.settlementPolicy === "page"
                                    opacity: enabled ? 1 : 0.5
                                    action: ArkToggleWrapper {
                                        checked: rmtoolNotePage.settlementPolicy === "page"
                                        extendedMouseArea.onPressed: rmtoolNotePage.writePolicy(
                                            "idle")
                                    }
                                }

                                ArkControls.Panel {
                                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                                    label: "提笔后延迟刷新"
                                    description: "每次提笔后重新计时，停止书写达到所选时间后完成彩色渲染。"
                                    enabled: rmtoolNotePage.masterEnabled
                                        && rmtoolNotePage.delayedColorRefreshEnabled
                                        && rmtoolNotePage.settlementPolicy === "idle"
                                    opacity: enabled ? 1 : 0.5
                                    action: ArkToggleWrapper {
                                        checked: rmtoolNotePage.settlementPolicy === "idle"
                                        extendedMouseArea.onPressed: rmtoolNotePage.writePolicy(
                                            "page")
                                    }
                                }

                                ArkControls.Panel {
                                    id: rmtoolColorDelayPanel
                                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                                    label: "空闲等待时间"
                                    description: "停止书写 %1 秒后完成彩色沉淀刷新。"
                                        .arg(rmtoolNotePage.delaySeconds)
                                    visible: rmtoolNotePage.masterEnabled
                                        && rmtoolNotePage.delayedColorRefreshEnabled
                                        && rmtoolNotePage.settlementPolicy === "idle"
                                    enabled: rmtoolNotePage.masterEnabled
                                        && rmtoolNotePage.delayedColorRefreshEnabled
                                        && rmtoolNotePage.settlementPolicy === "idle"
                                    opacity: enabled ? 1 : 0.5
                                    showAttachment: true
                                    attachment: RowLayout {
                                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                                        spacing: ArkControls.Values.spacing.medium

                                        ArkControls.Button {
                                            text: "-"
                                            type: ArkTokens.Button.secondary
                                            enabled: rmtoolColorDelayPanel.enabled
                                                && rmtoolNotePage.delaySeconds > 5
                                            onClicked: rmtoolNotePage.stepDelay(-1)
                                        }

                                        ArkControls.Button {
                                            text: rmtoolNotePage.delaySeconds + " 秒"
                                            type: ArkTokens.Button.secondary
                                            enabled: rmtoolColorDelayPanel.enabled
                                        }

                                        ArkControls.Button {
                                            text: "+"
                                            type: ArkTokens.Button.secondary
                                            enabled: rmtoolColorDelayPanel.enabled
                                                && rmtoolNotePage.delaySeconds < 30
                                            onClicked: rmtoolNotePage.stepDelay(1)
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/libs/toolbar/qml/SettingsMenu.qml
    TRAVERSE ToolbarTool#root > Component#settingsComponent > ColumnLayout#content
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL
        INSERT {
            ArkControls.FoldoutToggle {
                id: rmtoolNoteDelayToggle
                objectName: "rmtoolNoteDelayToggle"
                label: "延迟彩色刷新"
                visible: (root.toolbar.rmtoolNoteDocumentView?.rmtoolNoteEnhancementsAvailable
                    ?? false)
                    && (root.toolbar.rmtoolNoteDocumentView?.rmtoolNoteMasterEnabled
                        ?? false)
                checked: root.toolbar.rmtoolNoteDocumentView
                    ?.rmtoolNoteDocumentDelayEnabled ?? false
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                onClicked: {
                    const view = root.toolbar.rmtoolNoteDocumentView
                    view.rmtoolSetNoteDocumentDelayEnabled(
                        !view.rmtoolNoteDocumentDelayEnabled)
                    view.showNotification({
                        message: view.rmtoolNoteDocumentDelayEnabled
                            ? "本笔记已启用延迟彩色刷新"
                            : "本笔记已关闭延迟彩色刷新"
                    })
                }
            }

            ArkControls.FoldoutToggle {
                id: rmtoolNotePageOnlyToggle
                objectName: "rmtoolNotePageOnlyToggle"
                label: "仅翻页刷新"
                visible: (root.toolbar.rmtoolNoteDocumentView?.rmtoolNoteEnhancementsAvailable
                    ?? false)
                    && (root.toolbar.rmtoolNoteDocumentView?.rmtoolNoteMasterEnabled
                        ?? false)
                    && (root.toolbar.rmtoolNoteDocumentView
                        ?.rmtoolNoteDocumentDelayEnabled ?? false)
                checked: root.toolbar.rmtoolNoteDocumentView
                    ?.rmtoolNoteDocumentSettlementPolicy === "page"
                enabled: checked
                opacity: enabled ? 1 : 0.5
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                onPressed: {
                    const view = root.toolbar.rmtoolNoteDocumentView
                    view.rmtoolSetNoteDocumentSettlementPolicy("idle")
                }
            }

            ArkControls.FoldoutToggle {
                id: rmtoolNoteIdleToggle
                objectName: "rmtoolNoteIdleToggle"
                label: "提笔后延迟刷新"
                visible: (root.toolbar.rmtoolNoteDocumentView?.rmtoolNoteEnhancementsAvailable
                    ?? false)
                    && (root.toolbar.rmtoolNoteDocumentView?.rmtoolNoteMasterEnabled
                        ?? false)
                    && (root.toolbar.rmtoolNoteDocumentView
                        ?.rmtoolNoteDocumentDelayEnabled ?? false)
                checked: root.toolbar.rmtoolNoteDocumentView
                    ?.rmtoolNoteDocumentSettlementPolicy === "idle"
                enabled: checked
                opacity: enabled ? 1 : 0.5
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                onPressed: {
                    const view = root.toolbar.rmtoolNoteDocumentView
                    view.rmtoolSetNoteDocumentSettlementPolicy("page")
                }
            }

            Component {
                id: rmtoolNoteDelayOptions

                ColumnLayout {
                    spacing: 0

                    ArkControls.FoldoutItem {
                        label: "5 秒"
                        selected: root.toolbar.rmtoolNoteDocumentView
                            ?.rmtoolNoteDocumentDelaySeconds === 5
                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                        onClicked: {
                            root.toolbar.rmtoolNoteDocumentView
                                .rmtoolSetNoteDocumentDelaySeconds(5)
                            stackView.popCurrentItem()
                        }
                    }

                    ArkControls.FoldoutItem {
                        label: "10 秒"
                        selected: root.toolbar.rmtoolNoteDocumentView
                            ?.rmtoolNoteDocumentDelaySeconds === 10
                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                        onClicked: {
                            root.toolbar.rmtoolNoteDocumentView
                                .rmtoolSetNoteDocumentDelaySeconds(10)
                            stackView.popCurrentItem()
                        }
                    }

                    ArkControls.FoldoutItem {
                        label: "30 秒"
                        selected: root.toolbar.rmtoolNoteDocumentView
                            ?.rmtoolNoteDocumentDelaySeconds === 30
                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                        onClicked: {
                            root.toolbar.rmtoolNoteDocumentView
                                .rmtoolSetNoteDocumentDelaySeconds(30)
                            stackView.popCurrentItem()
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            ArkControls.FoldoutItem {
                id: rmtoolNoteDelaySelector
                objectName: "rmtoolNoteDelaySelector"
                label: "空闲等待时间"
                description: (root.toolbar.rmtoolNoteDocumentView
                    ?.rmtoolNoteDocumentDelaySeconds ?? 10) + " 秒"
                visible: (root.toolbar.rmtoolNoteDocumentView?.rmtoolNoteEnhancementsAvailable
                    ?? false)
                    && (root.toolbar.rmtoolNoteDocumentView?.rmtoolNoteMasterEnabled
                        ?? false)
                    && (root.toolbar.rmtoolNoteDocumentView
                        ?.rmtoolNoteDocumentDelayEnabled ?? false)
                    && root.toolbar.rmtoolNoteDocumentView
                        ?.rmtoolNoteDocumentSettlementPolicy !== "page"
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                onClicked: stackView.push(rmtoolNoteDelayOptions)
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qml/device/view/documentview/DocumentView.qml
    TRAVERSE FocusScope#root
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL
        INSERT {
            property bool rmtoolNoteMasterEnabled: true
            property bool rmtoolNoteDocumentDelayEnabled: false
            property int rmtoolNoteDocumentDelaySeconds: 10
            property string rmtoolNoteDocumentSettlementPolicy: "idle"
            readonly property bool rmtoolNoteEnhancementsAvailable: !!document
                && document.fileType === Document.Notebook
            readonly property string rmtoolNoteDocumentId: document
                && document.id !== undefined && document.id !== null
                ? document.id.toString() : ""

            onRmtoolNoteDocumentIdChanged: rmtoolReadNoteSettings()

            function rmtoolNoteDocumentKey(key) {
                if (!rmtoolNoteEnhancementsAvailable || !rmtoolNoteDocumentId) {
                    return ""
                }
                return "documents/" + rmtoolNoteDocumentId + "/" + key
            }

            function rmtoolNoteReadBool(key, fallback) {
                const value = Settings.rawValue("RmtoolNoteEnhancements", key)
                return value === undefined || value === null ? fallback : !!value
            }

            function rmtoolNoteNormalizedDelay(value) {
                const number = Number(value)
                return number === 5 || number === 10 || number === 30 ? number : 10
            }

            function rmtoolNoteNormalizedPolicy(value) {
                return value === "page" ? "page" : "idle"
            }

            function rmtoolNoteReadScopedBool(key, fallback) {
                const scopedKey = rmtoolNoteDocumentKey(key)
                return scopedKey ? rmtoolNoteReadBool(scopedKey, fallback) : fallback
            }

            function rmtoolNoteReadScopedDelay(key, fallback) {
                const scopedKey = rmtoolNoteDocumentKey(key)
                if (!scopedKey) {
                    return rmtoolNoteNormalizedDelay(fallback)
                }
                const value = Settings.rawValue("RmtoolNoteEnhancements", scopedKey)
                return value === undefined || value === null
                    ? rmtoolNoteNormalizedDelay(fallback)
                    : rmtoolNoteNormalizedDelay(value)
            }

            function rmtoolNoteReadScopedPolicy(key, fallback) {
                const scopedKey = rmtoolNoteDocumentKey(key)
                if (!scopedKey) {
                    return rmtoolNoteNormalizedPolicy(fallback)
                }
                const value = Settings.rawValue("RmtoolNoteEnhancements", scopedKey)
                return value === undefined || value === null
                    ? rmtoolNoteNormalizedPolicy(fallback)
                    : rmtoolNoteNormalizedPolicy(value)
            }

            function rmtoolReadNoteSettings() {
                const globalDelayEnabled = rmtoolNoteReadBool(
                    "delayedColorRefreshEnabled", false)
                const globalDelaySeconds = rmtoolNoteNormalizedDelay(
                    Settings.rawValue("RmtoolNoteEnhancements", "delaySeconds"))
                const globalPolicy = rmtoolNoteNormalizedPolicy(
                    Settings.rawValue("RmtoolNoteEnhancements", "settlementPolicy"))
                rmtoolNoteMasterEnabled = rmtoolNoteReadBool("masterEnabled", true)
                rmtoolNoteDocumentDelayEnabled = rmtoolNoteReadScopedBool(
                    "delayedColorRefreshEnabled", globalDelayEnabled)
                rmtoolNoteDocumentDelaySeconds = rmtoolNoteReadScopedDelay(
                    "delaySeconds", globalDelaySeconds)
                rmtoolNoteDocumentSettlementPolicy = rmtoolNoteReadScopedPolicy(
                    "settlementPolicy", globalPolicy)
            }

            function rmtoolNoteWriteDocumentValue(key, value) {
                const scopedKey = rmtoolNoteDocumentKey(key)
                if (!scopedKey) {
                    return
                }
                Settings.setRawValue("RmtoolNoteEnhancements", scopedKey, value)
                rmtoolReadNoteSettings()
                sceneView?.rmtoolNoteSettingsChanged()
            }

            function rmtoolSetNoteDocumentDelayEnabled(value) {
                rmtoolNoteWriteDocumentValue("delayedColorRefreshEnabled", !!value)
            }

            function rmtoolSetNoteDocumentDelaySeconds(value) {
                rmtoolNoteWriteDocumentValue(
                    "delaySeconds", rmtoolNoteNormalizedDelay(value))
            }

            function rmtoolSetNoteDocumentSettlementPolicy(value) {
                rmtoolNoteWriteDocumentValue(
                    "settlementPolicy", rmtoolNoteNormalizedPolicy(value))
            }

            Connections {
                target: root
                Component.onCompleted: root.rmtoolReadNoteSettings()

                function onVisibleChanged() {
                    if (root.visible) {
                        root.rmtoolReadNoteSettings()
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE

    TRAVERSE FocusScope#root
        REBUILD onInSuspendChanged
            LOCATE AFTER STREAM /{/
            INSERT {
                if (inSuspend) {
                    sceneView?.rmtoolSettlePendingColor()
                }
            }
        END REBUILD
    END TRAVERSE

    TRAVERSE FocusScope#root > Item#_uiContainer > Toolbar#toolbar
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL
        INSERT {
            property var rmtoolNoteDocumentView: root
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qml/device/view/documentview/DeviceSceneView.qml
    TRAVERSE FocusScope#root
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL
        INSERT {
            function rmtoolSettlePendingColor() {
                viewportUpdateTimer.rmtoolSettlePending()
            }

            function rmtoolNoteSettingsChanged() {
                viewportUpdateTimer.rmtoolNoteSettingsChanged()
            }
        }

        REBUILD close
            LOCATE BEFORE ALL
            INSERT {
                viewportUpdateTimer.rmtoolSettlePending()
            }
        END REBUILD

        REBUILD goToPageId
            LOCATE BEFORE ALL
            INSERT {
                viewportUpdateTimer.rmtoolSettlePending()
            }
        END REBUILD
    END TRAVERSE

    TRAVERSE ?#viewportUpdateTimer
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL
        INSERT {
            property rect rmtoolPendingDirtyRect: Qt.rect(0, 0, 0, 0)
            property bool rmtoolHasPendingDirty: false
            property bool rmtoolAwaitingStockFinalize: false

            function rmtoolNoteDocumentKey(key) {
                if (!root.document || root.document.fileType !== Document.Notebook
                    || root.document.id === undefined || root.document.id === null) {
                    return ""
                }
                return "documents/" + root.document.id.toString() + "/" + key
            }

            function rmtoolNoteNormalizedDelay(value) {
                const number = Number(value)
                return number === 5 || number === 10 || number === 30 ? number : 10
            }

            function rmtoolNoteNormalizedPolicy(value) {
                return value === "page" ? "page" : "idle"
            }

            function rmtoolNoteFeatureEnabled() {
                const group = "RmtoolNoteEnhancements"
                const master = Settings.rawValue(group, "masterEnabled")
                const globalFeature = Settings.rawValue(
                    group, "delayedColorRefreshEnabled")
                const featureKey = rmtoolNoteDocumentKey("delayedColorRefreshEnabled")
                if (!featureKey) {
                    return false
                }
                const documentFeature = featureKey
                    ? Settings.rawValue(group, featureKey) : undefined
                const feature = documentFeature === undefined || documentFeature === null
                    ? globalFeature === true : !!documentFeature
                return master !== false && feature
            }

            function rmtoolNoteCanDeferStroke() {
                return rmtoolNoteFeatureEnabled()
                    && documentViewTools.isWritingTool(documentViewTools.activePen.tool)
            }

            function rmtoolNoteSettlementPolicy() {
                const group = "RmtoolNoteEnhancements"
                const globalPolicy = rmtoolNoteNormalizedPolicy(
                    Settings.rawValue(group, "settlementPolicy"))
                const policyKey = rmtoolNoteDocumentKey("settlementPolicy")
                const documentPolicy = policyKey
                    ? Settings.rawValue(group, policyKey) : undefined
                return documentPolicy === undefined || documentPolicy === null
                    ? globalPolicy : rmtoolNoteNormalizedPolicy(documentPolicy)
            }

            function rmtoolNoteRefreshInterval() {
                if (!rmtoolNoteFeatureEnabled()) {
                    return 1000
                }
                const group = "RmtoolNoteEnhancements"
                const globalSeconds = rmtoolNoteNormalizedDelay(
                    Settings.rawValue(group, "delaySeconds"))
                const delayKey = rmtoolNoteDocumentKey("delaySeconds")
                const documentSeconds = delayKey
                    ? Settings.rawValue(group, delayKey) : undefined
                const seconds = documentSeconds === undefined || documentSeconds === null
                    ? globalSeconds : rmtoolNoteNormalizedDelay(documentSeconds)
                return seconds * 1000 - 1000
            }

            function rmtoolQueueDirty(dirtyRect) {
                if (!rmtoolHasPendingDirty) {
                    rmtoolPendingDirtyRect = dirtyRect
                    rmtoolHasPendingDirty = true
                    return
                }
                const x = Math.min(rmtoolPendingDirtyRect.x, dirtyRect.x)
                const y = Math.min(rmtoolPendingDirtyRect.y, dirtyRect.y)
                const right = Math.max(
                    rmtoolPendingDirtyRect.x + rmtoolPendingDirtyRect.width,
                    dirtyRect.x + dirtyRect.width)
                const bottom = Math.max(
                    rmtoolPendingDirtyRect.y + rmtoolPendingDirtyRect.height,
                    dirtyRect.y + dirtyRect.height)
                rmtoolPendingDirtyRect = Qt.rect(x, y, right - x, bottom - y)
            }

            function rmtoolSettlePending() {
                if (!rmtoolHasPendingDirty && !rmtoolAwaitingStockFinalize) {
                    return
                }
                viewportUpdateTimer.stop()
                if (rmtoolHasPendingDirty) {
                    root.viewport?.markDirty(rmtoolPendingDirtyRect)
                }
                rmtoolHasPendingDirty = false
                rmtoolPendingDirtyRect = Qt.rect(0, 0, 0, 0)
                rmtoolAwaitingStockFinalize = false
                inputSurface.clearFramebuffer()
                root.viewport?.requestRepaintDirty()
            }

            function rmtoolSubmitPending() {
                if (!rmtoolHasPendingDirty) {
                    return false
                }
                root.viewport?.markDirty(rmtoolPendingDirtyRect)
                rmtoolHasPendingDirty = false
                rmtoolPendingDirtyRect = Qt.rect(0, 0, 0, 0)
                rmtoolAwaitingStockFinalize = true
                return true
            }

            function rmtoolNoteSettingsChanged() {
                if (!rmtoolNoteFeatureEnabled()) {
                    viewportUpdateTimer.interval = 1000
                    if (rmtoolSubmitPending()) {
                        viewportUpdateTimer.restart()
                    }
                    return
                }
                if (!rmtoolHasPendingDirty) {
                    return
                }
                if (rmtoolNoteSettlementPolicy() === "page") {
                    if (rmtoolAwaitingStockFinalize) {
                        viewportUpdateTimer.interval = 1000
                        viewportUpdateTimer.restart()
                    } else {
                        viewportUpdateTimer.stop()
                    }
                } else {
                    viewportUpdateTimer.interval = rmtoolNoteRefreshInterval()
                    viewportUpdateTimer.restart()
                }
            }
        }

        REPLACE interval WITH {
            interval: 1000
        }

        REBUILD markDirtyAndRestart
            LOCATE BEFORE ALL
            INSERT {
                if (viewportUpdateTimer.rmtoolNoteCanDeferStroke()) {
                    viewportUpdateTimer.rmtoolQueueDirty(dirtyRect)
                    if (viewportUpdateTimer.rmtoolNoteSettlementPolicy() === "page") {
                        viewportUpdateTimer.stop()
                    } else {
                        viewportUpdateTimer.interval = viewportUpdateTimer
                            .rmtoolNoteRefreshInterval()
                        viewportUpdateTimer.restart()
                    }
                    return
                } else {
                    viewportUpdateTimer.interval = 1000
                    viewportUpdateTimer.rmtoolSubmitPending()
                }
            }
        END REBUILD

        REBUILD onTriggered
            LOCATE AFTER STREAM /{/
            INSERT {
                if (viewportUpdateTimer.rmtoolAwaitingStockFinalize
                    && (viewportUpdateTimer.rmtoolNoteSettlementPolicy() === "page"
                        || !viewportUpdateTimer.rmtoolHasPendingDirty)) {
                    if (strokeHandler.timeSincePenUp() >= 100) {
                        viewportUpdateTimer.rmtoolAwaitingStockFinalize = false
                    }
                } else if (viewportUpdateTimer.rmtoolHasPendingDirty) {
                    if (viewportUpdateTimer.rmtoolNoteSettlementPolicy() === "page") {
                        viewportUpdateTimer.stop()
                        return
                    }
                    if (strokeHandler.timeSincePenUp() < 100) {
                        viewportUpdateTimer.restart()
                        return
                    }
                    if (viewportUpdateTimer.rmtoolSubmitPending()) {
                        viewportUpdateTimer.interval = 1000
                        viewportUpdateTimer.restart()
                    }
                    return
                }
            }
        END REBUILD
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
